name: stacking-card
title: Stacking Card
blurb: Scroll-driven stacking cards with image and photographer profile.
description: A photographer portfolio using ReactLenis scroll physics. Cards stack and scale down as user scrolls, with images and bio text revealed sequentially.
use_when: Portfolio showcases, photography galleries, or storytelling layouts where scroll-driven stacking creates visual rhythm…
avoid_when: Content-light pages where excessive scrolling might frustrate users, or non-portfolio contexts where stacking metaphor…
a11y: Text content is readable and semantic. Scroll-driven animations may conflict with accessibility tools; test with screen readers.
